bibl.title: PSI XIV 1400: appunti inediti di Achille Vogliano.
bibl.seg: Anna Di Giglio, PSI XIV 1400: appunti inediti di Achille Vogliano.
bibl.note: In the Florentine Academy of Papyrology and Studies on the Ancient World in Florence, there are the papers belonging to Achille Vogliano. In this precious material there are the sheets containing Vogliano's notes for a new edition of P.S.I. XIV, 1400 (= MP3 2565; LDAB 6421). So, Vogliano's edition must be inserted between the one of Medea Norsa (1938) and the one of Adelmo Barigazzi (1949).
